integrity: All local p-parts are defined from exact positive recurrence values; full proof and standalone exact-integer checks included. Novelty of the derived Dold classification is qualified by possible unindexed earlier equivalent results.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to first-kind Lucas U(P,-1) with integer P >= 2; uses published general p-adic valuation lemma. No assertion for arbitrary Q or higher-order recurrence. Finite verification is corroborative, not an infinite proof. Historical priority is best-knowledge, not independently certified.
title: Local Dold and realization dichotomy for first-kind Pell–Lucas families
